purpose: Consolidate overlapping GFC rally launch days into independent rally episodes, then compare early causal characteristics of failed violent recoveries with the durable March 2009 emergence.

episode_generator.qualification: broad-panel price subsequently rises at least 7% within 20 sessions
episode_generator.episode_merge: All qualifying candidate lows belong to one episode until either (a) a new low below the episode launch low occurs after a rally of at least 7%, ending that episode and permitting a new one, or (b) 30 trading sessions elapse from launch; retain the lowest launch price/date within overlapping pre-rally candidates.
episode_generator.independence: One feature vector series per consolidated rally episode; overlapping launch dates are never counted as independent examples.
episode_generator.labeling: An episode is false if price subsequently breaks below its launch low before 2009-03-09; March 2009 is the durable true reference.

rules: Future data may label and score outcomes but never enter a contemporaneous descriptor.
Reference trough is descriptive only and never a gate.
Preserve each false episode individually; do not average away heterogeneity.
Do not fit thresholds or trading rules in this experiment.
Prioritize whether useful separation exists by sessions 1-15.
No protected banks, no portfolio fitness.
qualification: Current-S&P broad panel survivorship qualification; OFR publication lag two business days.
